title: Excavation Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Excavation Job Safety Analysis template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.
html:
Project Information

JSA ID: EXCAV-__________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________

PROJECT: ______________ LOCATION: ______________ DEPTH: ______________ ft

SOIL TYPE: ☐ A ☐ B ☐ C COMPETENT PERSON: ______________ CREW SIZE: ______________

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Pre-Excav ation Planning-Utilities
-Unknown underground obstructions		-Electrocution
-Gas explosion
-Service disruption		25 (VERY HIGH)-Call 811 for utility locate
-Hand dig within 3' of marked lines
-Review utility as-builts
-Obtain all permits
2. Soil Analysis-Improper classification
-Hidden hazards		-Cave-in
-Worker burial
-Death		20 (VERY HIGH)-Classify soil type (A, B, or C)
-Test soil for stability
-Check for previous disturbance
-Monitor for water seepage
3. Protection System Selection-No shoring
-Improper sloping
-Wrong system		-Cave-in
-Crush injuries
-Death		25 (VERY HIGH)-Slope back to angle of repose
-Install trench box/shoring
-Use benching for deep cuts
-Engineer-designed for >20ft
4. Excavation Operations-Heavy equipment
-Spoil piles
-Edge loading		-Struck by
-Run over
-Roll-in		16 (HIGH)-Keep equipment 2' from edge
-Use spotter for backup
-Spoil piles 2' from edge minimum
-Barricade work area
5. Daily Inspections-Changing conditions
-Rain/weather
-Vibration		-Unnoticed hazards
-Cave-in		20 (VERY HIGH)-Competent person inspects daily
-Inspect after rain/weather events
-Document all inspections
-Check for cracks/spalling
6. Entry/Exit & Egress-No ladder
-Improper ladder placement		-Fall from height
-Unable to escape		12 (HIGH)-Ladder within 25' of workers
-Extend ladder 3' above grade
-Secure ladder at top
-Maintain clear path
